properties.notes: The site has been allocated for mixed-use development (up to 1,000sqm retail/ leisure and approx. 40 homes) in the Development Management Plan (site allocation policy HOR1). The scope of the 'Delivering Change in Horley Town Centre' revitalisation programme which includes this project was approved by Executive September 2020. Executive also approved £37,600 from Reigate & Banstead Borough Council's Commercial Ventures (Feasibility Studies) Reserve to progress a feasibility and options study in relation to the development of the High Street Carpark.
